result:
The direction is implemented, verified and committed. The live AWS stop was not exercised, as the brief directs.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/evaluation/agentcore_eval.py` — new `stop_batch_evaluation(client, *, batch_id)` wrapper beside get/start.
- `backend/app/evaluation/queue.py` — `EvalRunQueue.cancel(run_id)` drops a pending run; the worker skips cancelled ids on dequeue.
- `backend/app/evaluation/service.py` — stop flags polled between prompts and before StartBatchEvaluation, `RunStopped` exit to status `stopped`, race-closing forward of the stop right after the batch starts, `STOPPED` mapped to `stopped` with partial scores or insight trees, new `request_stop()` and `stop_requested()`.
- `backend/app/evaluation/routers.py` — `POST /api/eval/runs/{run_id}/stop` (202, 404, 409) and additive `stop_requested` on every run row.
- `backend/app/core/route_policy.py` — registers the new POST with the create_run posture.
- `backend/app/evaluation/models.py` — status comment lists `stopped`.
- `backend/tests/evaluation/test_run_stop.py` — 14 hermetic tests, all named `test_eval_stop_*`.
- `frontend/src/lib/evaluation.ts` — `EvaluationRunStatus` union including `stopped`, `stop_requested`, `isActiveRun` helper.
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `api.stopEvaluationRun(runId)`.
- `frontend/src/pages/Evaluation.tsx` — STOP button on active rows and in run detail with `disabledReason`, shared ConfirmDialog with per-exit copy, STOPPED and STOPPING chips, stopped reason block and partial-scores note, insights duplicate guard treats `stopped` as terminal.
- `frontend/src/locales/en/common.json`, `zh-CN/common.json` — new `evalPage.status.stopped/stopping` and `evalPage.runs.stop.*` keys.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — new Console Evaluation Runs API section documenting the stop route.
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — Evaluation row mentions stop/cancel and the `stopped` status.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `-k "eval and stop"` — 14 tests cover: evaluating run calls `stop_batch_evaluation` with the ledger batch id and returns 202 with the run; completed, failed and stopped runs return 409 `run.not_active` in the envelope; queued run is cancelled with AWS never called and the worker skips its callable on dequeue; poller keeps polling through `STOPPING` and maps `STOPPED` with partial `evaluatorScores` to `stopped` with parsed scores; plus replay abort, post-start race forwarding, restart reconciliation and terminal-for-resume.
- ✅ `tests/test_route_policy.py` + `tests/test_client_funnel.py` — 410 passed.
- ✅ Frontend tsc and lint pass; `api.ts` has `stopEvaluationRun`; `evaluation.ts` run type carries `stopped`; i18n parity and zh-CN punctuation clean.
- ✅ Both api docs list the stop route; both architecture Evaluation rows mention stop/cancel and `stopped`.
- ✅ `make verify` PASS in this worktree.
- ✅ Live AWS check not required. The live stop was not exercised. No AWS calls were made.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Route prefix is `/api/eval`, not `/api/evaluation`.** The existing evaluation router mounts at `/api/eval`, so the route is `POST /api/eval/runs/{run_id}/stop`. The brief's path did not exist anywhere in the codebase.
- **Route posture follows the brief** (`perm:eval.run`, same as create_run). Note the analogous online-config pause route is plain MEMBER since stopping starts no billable work. Easy to relax if the host prefers.
- **Response is 202** for every exit, matching the AWS operation. A queued cancel already comes back as `stopped` in that response.
- **Telemetry wait is not interrupted mid-wait.** A stop during the `waiting` phase takes effect right after the wait returns, before StartBatchEvaluation, as the brief specified. Interrupting the wait loop itself would mean threading a flag into `telemetry.py`, which I left out of scope.
- **`stop_requested` is an additive, in-memory field** on run rows so the console can show STOPPING and refuse a second click. It is not persisted, and a restart fails pre-batch runs honestly as before.
- **Frontend was not exercised in a browser.** Verification is tsc, eslint and the vite build only.
